text: Two fact tables, sharing dimensions — still a star schema, just with a bigger diagram.
Every dimension connects to both fact tables where it applies. Build these one-to-many, dimension on the one side, exactly like Chapter Four taught.
FactInternetSales has three date roles, but only one relationship can be active. This is the exact scenario Chapter Six used to teach USERELATIONSHIP — and Lesson 88 puts it to work.
Since the relationship runs through a whole-number key, not the date column itself, DimDate has to be explicitly marked — auto date-time won't cover this on its own.
Model built, relationships correct. Lesson 88 writes the DAX measures that actually answer Lesson 84's four requirements.
